svg.title: LTC-25000 illustrative profile / 0.5-67 GHz / Cu 2.2 um / MPI GSG 150 um
svg.desc: Actual resonator2.bas drawing statements rendered on the host. Source-derived preview, not an app screenshot. Legacy grounded model is inapplicable to actual ungrounded PI/EME-G730 stack. All numerical labels are hypothetical backplane-reference results only. Geometry view uses source scaling and one-pixel minimum trace width.
svg.text: RING DESIGNER V1.1 / FIRST-PASS RF DESIGN
05 / ASSUMPTIONS AND CHECKS
CONSTRUCTION / MODEL
Continuous backside ground.
Tie both GSG grounds to it.
Add low-inductance vias/bonds.
W/E active; N/S heads parked.
Bulk isotropic Er; air above.
No dielectric stack or coating.
No loss, Q, or S21 prediction.
EM-tune tapers and ring gaps.
CHECKS FOR THIS DESIGN
GCPW METAL NOT THIN VERSUS W/S
MICROSTRIP METAL NOT THIN VS W
Cosine lobes differ from the paper's circular arcs.
TAP: NEXT PAGE M: MENU
